scientific_integrity: Nine-period upper bound and examples are acknowledged as known. Eight-word classification computed exhaustively by two independently formulated exact algorithms; no claim of independent auditing or general-alphabet theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for ternary cyclic order-three orientable words of period nine; excludes shorter periods, larger alphabets, longer windows, and palindrome-covering unoriented de Bruijn sequences. Historical priority not independently certified; 1993 sources are year-dated only, whereas 2003-11-07 is the earliest day-verified inspected reversal-avoidance preprint.
title: Complete classification of maximum ternary order-three orientable cycles
